title: Solomon sends Benaiah at once — Brenton’s Greek prints an exchange between Solomon and Joab first
summary: In the KJV of 1 Kings 2:29 Solomon hears that Joab is at the altar and sends Benaiah with the words “Go, fall upon him”. Brenton’s Greek prints a message from Solomon to Joab, “What has happened to you, that you have fled to the altar?”, and Joab’s answer, “Because I was afraid of you”, before Benaiah is sent.
text: KJV 1 Kings 2:29: “And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the Lord; and, behold, he is by the altar. title: Jeroboam’s mother “a widow woman” — Brenton’s Greek prints “a widow” at 11:26 and “a harlot” at 12:24b
summary: The KJV of 1 Kings 11:26 calls Jeroboam’s mother Zeruah, “a widow woman”. Brenton’s Greek of 11:26 also has a widow (χήρας), but the Greek addition at 12:24b says his mother’s name was Sarira, γυνὴ πόρνη, “a harlot”.

[and Jeroboam son of Nabat the Ephrathite, from Sarira, son of a widow woman, servant of Solomon] Second place.
